case.summary: Case CASE-020 involves three card-not-present transactions (4012182, 4012184, 4012183) totaling $97.42 exposure on card SC-03020-K954. The real-time model scored transaction 4012182 ($37.42, domestic) at 0.88 risk [EV-dc2102e3]. That transaction originated from a previously unseen iOS device profile and an anonymous proxy connection routed through Argentina [EV-9cbb6590, EV-77912d89]. Three online transactions occurred on the card within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-e4d59dfe]. The customer disputes the purchases and confirms physical possession of the card [EV-e66dc0b3]. Prior fraud history includes one confirmed case for this customer/card (CC-4325) [EV-f216828f] and the same device profile appearing in one confirmed fraud case [EV-47be1fd9]; six prior closed cases share the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-a1e69aa5].

sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report draft for CASE-020. The investigation identified a cluster of three card-not-present transactions on card SC-03020-K954 with a combined exposure of $97.42. The initial transaction (4012182) was scored at 0.88 by the real-time risk model and exhibited two high-risk indicators: a brand-new iOS device fingerprint not previously associated with the account [EV-9cbb6590] and an anonymous proxy connection exiting in Argentina [EV-77912d89]. Velocity analysis shows three online transactions on the same card within a 48-hour window [EV-e4d59dfe], consistent with rapid monetization of compromised credentials. The cardholder explicitly denies authorizing any of the purchases and confirms the physical card remains in their possession [EV-e66dc0b3]. Historical review reveals one prior confirmed fraud case linked to this customer/card (CC-4325) [EV-f216828f] and the identical device profile surfacing in another confirmed fraud case [EV-47be1fd9]. Pattern retrieval returns six prior closed cases matching the card_not_present_new_device signature [EV-a1e69aa5], reinforcing the typology. The convergence of new-device, proxy-anonymized, high-velocity, card-not-present activity with customer dispute and device-profile recidivism supports classification as fraudulent card-not-present abuse.
